scope: CPU synthetic base-class stub and old-record owner fixture; not HF training/model/task evidence

postcal_fixture.read_byte_scope: logical residual/base/text payload plus predeclared metadata/query/selector scratch charge; not measured physical DRAM
postcal_fixture.backend: packed all-support G4_256/G4_16 V1 with compact zero/one/two-stage K/V sign residuals and one online softmax
postcal_fixture.compression_point: after last visual token, before complete first-question suffix
postcal_fixture.prefill_work_scope: native causal prefix extracted via full prefill, later native suffix discarded and charged replayed; no extraction-speed claim
postcal_fixture.budget_scope: per forward aggregate cap = fraction * full residual payload, selection included; page selectors additionally cap each layer
postcal_fixture.headwise_fallback_scope: no learned decoder table; global fixed book for every image
postcal_fixture.encoding_assignment: declared source-normalized nearest assignment; original norm/factor FP16 fold
postcal_fixture.constant_scope: both encoder and decoder books charged once per cache; no stored Hadamard matrix; query FWHT scratch is charged separately
postcal_fixture.calibration_parameter_scope: FP32 encoder-only factors folded into existing FP16 key row gains/means and value scale/minimum; counted separately in eligibility
postcal_fixture.key_gain_rule: post-residual absolute head scale after originalnorm/f0/signMAD
postcal_fixture.key_gain_rounding: original norm/f0 FP16 and signMAD, then one FP32 head factor into existingFP16 g and all K alphas

key_factor_inheritance.scope: All numerical key/value factors copied unchanged; no refit or new-book calibration claim

postcal_fixture.depth_residual_format: RC[M,N,4] int32 + alpha[M,N] FP16; lookup[L,2,Hkv,2] int32; only actual selected stages stored
postcal_fixture.depth_residual_K_reference: centered WHT source K minus actual sequential FP16 reconstruction; frozen mean unchanged
postcal_fixture.depth_residual_V_reference: source V minus actual sequential FP16 reconstruction from calibrated V1 base

depth_residual_distortions.scope: real packed sign stage and actual sequential FP16 decode; coordinate error, not task quality

postcal_fixture.stage: round8 fixed-J/sign post-residual teacher-KL head calibration
postcal_fixture.metadata_factor_policy: explicit numerical inheritance from frozen reference; no new-book refit
postcal_fixture.value_affine_rounding: FP16 multiplication then FP16 addition; no FMA
postcal_fixture.joint_gain_scope: stored effective gain and existing first K alpha; codes/sign/mean unchanged
postcal_fixture.postcal_scope: Original R42 packed fields first; only existing g/S/m/alpha changed once by frozen absolute head factors; no J/sign re-encoding
postcal_fixture.postcal_K_formula: F16(old_g*fK), F16(all existing K alpha*fK); original mean retained
postcal_fixture.postcal_V_formula: F16(old_S*fV), centered min shift from oldS, F16(all existing V alpha*fV)
postcal_fixture.depth_residual_distortions_scope: Pre-postcal initialization only; not the final transformed reconstruction error
